Veterans Benefits: Washington does not levy an individual state income tax on wages or military retirement income. Qualified disabled veterans and surviving spouses may also qualify for Washington property-tax relief subject to disability, residency and income requirements.
Description: Hamilton is a tiny Skagit County town in the upper Skagit Valley near the Cascade foothills. Despite having only about 300 residents, it hosts a major and rapidly expanding Janicki Industries aerospace and defense manufacturing campus, giving the town an unusually large advanced-manufacturing footprint relative to its population.
